protocol.objective: Within the admitted exposed development folds, assess whether bounded Agent factor selection and allocation improve on frozen deterministic research; retain negative and failed trials; recommend only development evidence.

primary.selection: Agent value uses each run's explicit final factor-set/allocator recommendation only; no recommendation is NOT_SUPPORTED. Candidate gate separately ranks all completed primary pool/allocator pairs.

randomness.provider_responses: independent stochastic calls; no cherry-picked restart

protocol.run_isolation: fresh ledger, library copy, context; identical objective/pool/budgets/provider; independent responses; no cross-run feedback
protocol.stopping_rule: Explicit finalize or hard tool/token/cost/wall-clock ceiling stops a run. Proposal/evaluation ceilings deny further actions of that kind but permit remaining bounded inspection/finalization. All three primary runs required. Any infrastructure failure stops campaign; no result-dependent extension.
protocol.terminal_rule: system failure => SYSTEM_FAILURE; else highest ranked viable primary candidate => ADAPTIVE_CANDIDATE; else NO_ADAPTIVE_CANDIDATE; Agent value assessed independently
